description: TEST FIXTURE for editable_paths deletion authority (R2). Proves Step 0g-delete: deletions whose every target canonicalizes under an editable path / CWD / temp form are ALLOWED (tier editable_delete); system/foreign/unresolvable targets still ask. Deleters stay registered as modifying/high so the carve-out (not a tier change) is what flips them.
_comment_editable_paths: c:\temp\ is the editable folder. Everything under it (any depth) is deletable without an ask. NOTE: windows entries are RAW REGEX (not escaped), so backslashes must be doubled in JSON -> C:\\\\temp\\\\ compiles to regex C:\\temp\\ which matches literal c:\temp\.
_comment_system_paths: Default Windows system set. Deletions touching these ALWAYS ask (INV-3), never over-rulable. windows entries are RAW REGEX too -> double the backslashes.

PowerShell._comment_modifying: Deleters registered as modifying/high (today's behavior). Step 0g-delete carves out editable/CWD/temp targets BEFORE these tiers fire.
